  Details:
  Media-archive GPS/geo-tagging section (continuation of the YouTube description cleanup):
  
  1. **GPS in media cache (PR #269, merged 16:08)** — added latitude/longitude/gps_source fields to youtube_videos.json schema + backfill script (add_gps_to_youtube_videos_json.py) reading exact EXIF from source files via exiftool (DMS→decimal, S/W negative). 5 IMG entries backfilled with real plot precision (-3.2925, -52.5724).
  
  2. **SOP lock-in (PR #885, merged 16:09)** — documented GPS as part of the uniform media-cache format in DOWNLOADS_MEDIA_TO_AGROVERSE.md.
  
  3. **GPS at upload ingress (PR #270, merged 17:01)** — wired GPS capture into both upload paths (youtube_batch_incoming.py + upload_bean_lowercase_episodes.py) via exported gps_for_source() helper, so every future upload auto-geo-tags from the source file while in hand. Verified on real MOVs from two farms.
  
  4. **Farm manifests investigation + 115-item exact-EXIF backfill** — joined cache↔manifest↔source files, found farm manifests (cleide/paulo/rancho/santa-anna) carried yt_id but gps:null; backfilled exact EXIF GPS into 3 manifests (65+37+13) with surgical format-preserving diff (pure GPS-only, cross-validated against youtube_videos.json).
  
  5. **Migration to dedicated farm_media_manifests repo + cleanup** — verified governor's migration (new numeric latitude/longitude schema, already carrying GPS), confirmed service registration live post-PR #383, dropped obsolete gps/farm-manifest-backfill branch, aligned daemon builder to new schema (PR #10, merged 17:55) so future manifest-commit emits numeric GPS.
  
  Result: media archive is geo-searchable by lat/lon across youtube_videos.json + farm_media_manifests, GPS captured at ingress for all future uploads, pipeline+docs aligned. Total engaged time ≈ 300 min.
